title: Clarifying desire so pleasure can begin

captions.physics: Agreeing time and participation for both

meaning: Understanding an actual wish supports leisure together when agreed time moves beyond endless preparation for a more suitable meeting.
text: Time can be fairly agreed while the purpose of the coming leisure remains unclear. Justice in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps choose conditions and share participation. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards keeping enjoyment waiting, revising plans instead of beginning. Judgement in emotions allows a realisation: you suddenly understand the time together you actually await. It may be simpler than the prepared programme. A fresh perspective helps by returning desire to an available form, beyond requiring everything to be postponed once more.

Suppose you agreed to sort shared photographs over an elaborate dinner at home. Preparation keeps moving until you discover that quiet remembering matters most, beyond cooking a complicated meal. **A clarified wish can receive a simple form today.** Tea and a few pictures already create room for enjoyment. You can revise conditions through free agreement, preserving fairness without defending each original item because time and effort were mentally assigned to it.

The difficulty is making the discovered meaning another condition for complete readiness. Pictures must now be chosen more precisely and conversation prepared better so the meeting will be meaningful. Waiting continues under another name. Realisation supports leisure when it permits a living trial. It can be experienced within a small free moment without requiring both to confirm its full meaning or receive equally profound impressions from every photograph.
